integrity: The proof starts from the exact XLindley density and PTS-XL construction printed in the 2026 primary source. The source PDF was inspected at the model definition, PMF, PGF, and MGF sections, and its PGF was independently reconstructed. The earlier PXL full text and the original XLindley source were inspected for implication comparison. The standalone symbolic checker is supplementary to the algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: The representation is a model-specific structural decomposition, not a new general theorem about mixed Poisson laws.
PTS-XL is a three-component negative-binomial mixture, not generally a single negative-binomial distribution.
No claim is made that the decomposition improves every inference or fitting procedure in the source.
title: PTS-XL is exactly a three-negative-binomial mixture and a two-fold PXL convolution
